html/events#

A deterministic event tokenizer for one already available string.

Version: v1.0.0

Synopsis#

let handler = PrintingHtmlEvents(output: Stdout());
for HtmlEvents(origin: document) -> event {
    event.dispatch(handler);
}

Description#

A deterministic event tokenizer for one already available string.

HtmlEvents never reads a file, URL, DTD or other external resource. It does not construct or repair a browser DOM. Event order and attribute order are source order. ASCII tag and attribute names are normalized to lowercase.

Character references use the pinned 2,231-entry WHATWG-compatible named table and HTML numeric recovery. References are decoded in ordinary text and attribute values. Contents of script and style are raw text and remain undecoded until the matching end tag.

Malformed markup is recovered into a deterministic best-effort event stream. The tokenizer never inserts implicit html/head/body/table elements and never attempts browser-equivalent tree construction.
